paper.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
paper.note: 用户给的'DecisionRAG:让决策模型参与寻找资料'是中文意译/方法名,真实论文标题是Retriever-Free Retrieval,二者不矛盾已对齐
paper.equal_contribution: Chao Wan 与 Paul Jünger († Equal contribution)

core_claim.capability_asymmetry: retriever漏掉的证据,再强的generator也捞不回来;检索器仍停留BM25词频/固定向量近邻,与生成模型能力严重不对称(Figure 1)
core_claim.decision_model: Jev (TypeSafe AI 2026):给定共享context和一组问题,单次前向即对每题每个选项给出概率分布(yes/no题即P(Yes)),不采样任何token,并行判多候选
core_claim.navigate_not_search: 像人逛图书馆:从宽泛主题沿语料固有结构(主题→文档→章节→段落)逐层判断哪些分支值得深入;每个level一次前向,不生成token;无第一阶段检索器、无预建索引、无任务特定训练
core_claim.shared_context: 候选放同一上下文一起打分才可比:a candidate that would look relevant on its own receives a lower P(Yes) when a clearly better one is present——单独看着相关的候选,在更好候选面前P(Yes)被压低,概率因此被校准可比
core_claim.complexity: T(N)≈t_req·⌈log_b N⌉,平衡层级下顺序决策数随语料规模对数增长(Algorithm 1, Eq.4)

datasets_four_benchmarks.MultiDoc2Dial: 4 centers / 413 pages / 4,110 passages; 4,201 turns; gold=1 passage
datasets_four_benchmarks.ConditionalQA: 652 pages / 58,483 paragraphs; 285 questions(271 labeled); gold=1-22 paragraphs
datasets_four_benchmarks.MTRAG_IBM_Cloud: 172 products / 8,578 pages / 72,442 passages; 205 turns(188 labeled); gold=1-7 passages
datasets_four_benchmarks.Natural_Questions_DAPR: 1,000 clusters / 108,626 pages / 2.68M paragraphs; 500 test questions; gold=1-3 paragraphs

Table2_retrieval_no_task_training.claim_from_abstract: outperforms dense+8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 on MultiDoc2Dial (48.5-33.6=14.9 或 47.4-33.6=13.8,后者对应abstract口径) and 17.4 Hit@1 on NQ (66.4-48.0=18.4 或 65.4-48.0=17.4,后者对应abstract口径)
Table2_retrieval_no_task_training.honest_caveat: 九个主指标格里DecisionRAG并非全赢:如NQ R@10 DecisionRAG_Jev=86.7 < Dense=87.2;CQA Hit@1裸Jev 69.7 < GPT5 73.4(加dense后才73.4追平);四个基准九个格子赢约六格输约三格(二手icorer口径,一手逐格数已列上)

Table4_task_trained.claim: 60.7 超过best published task-trained retriever(SFRe2g 55.0) by 5.7 points

Table5_latency_cost.decisions_vs_generation: GPT-5逐token生成决策 vs DecisionRAG: 34-145x slower, 21-25x more expensive,且accuracy无一致增益(CQA GPT5领先4.1但NQ落后6.0)

Section6_1_shared_context.separate_vs_shared: Hit@1 47.8%(each candidate separate request) → 54.3%(50 candidates/request), 更大request几乎无额外收益;200全量多选排序60.6%比二元judgment 54.3%再高6.8点
Section6_1_shared_context.full_pipeline: MultiDoc2Dial passages of all selected pages scored together raises R@1 from 36.7% to 44.4% (+7.7 points, 95%CI [3.3,12.2])

Section6_3_navigation_vs_rerank.claim: navigate hierarchy outperforms reranking retriever candidates: CQA Hit@1 +7.7 (CI[2.6,13.3]), NQ +7.0 ([3.4,10.8]), MD2D与MTRAG平
Section6_3_navigation_vs_rerank.CRITICAL_recall_vs_rank1: dense top100 contains gold more often than navigated candidates (NQ 98.4% vs 94.0%; CQA 98.5% vs 91.1%), BUT when both contain it, navigation ranks it first more often (NQ 70.1% vs 61.9%; CQA 76.7% vs 67.3%) — 召回上限高≠首位命中高,整体页按阅读顺序呈现而非孤立段落

limitations_authors_stated: Section7: 依赖语料层级结构与节点描述,组织差的文档或无信息量描述会伤害检索质量
Section7: navigation剪枝不可逆(prunes branches irreversibly),祖先被丢弃则相关段落永远找不到;更大exploration budget与补充dense retrieval可缓解
Section6.6: 顶层剪枝既是便宜的原因也是丢证据之处,需研究保留多少cluster才能匹配全量打分召回
Appendix E.1: 不同ID下相同段落的评估敏感性; E.2: ConditionalQA在DAPR相关性判定下的敏感性
gold evidence占比: dense top100召回上限更高但首位命中更低(见CRITICAL_recall_vs_rank1)
